spec.purpose: Combined/boundary screen with larger normal tension and the original shear range; not yet a frozen training domain
spec.scope: Predeclared finite screen on unchanged cached meshes. Normal tension alone is extended from 0.10 to 0.20; compression and Green shear keep their previously screened bounds. New targets continue from corresponding saved original-box states; three exact endpoints per mesh are reused with provenance. Two selected targets per mesh are independently reached from zero. Physical screens are sampled, not stability/contact/uniqueness proofs. No data campaign, training or material-law change. Do not relax thresholds after viewing results.
